contract.implementation: workspace/event_summary.py: summarize(events) -> dict; command line takes source path and output path, writes UTF-8 JSON only after successful validation

common.input: A JSON array. Each object has exactly id, seq, at_ms, state, duration_ms. id is a nonempty string (including whitespace-only strings is invalid; preserve other original id bytes). seq is a positive integer; at_ms and duration_ms are nonnegative integers. bool is not an integer. state is exactly ok, failed or pending. Reject malformed shape, missing/extra keys, wrong types or invalid values with ValueError; no partial result. Do not coerce types or normalize IDs.
common.output: Exactly items, counts, total_ms, complete. items sorted by Unicode code point id, each chosen row retains exactly the five input fields. counts has exactly ok, failed, pending and counts only chosen items. total_ms sums chosen duration_ms. complete is true iff items is nonempty and every selected state is ok; empty input returns zero counts, zero total, false. summarize is a pure function of events: no filesystem, environment or other external input/output. Never mutate the caller's input.
common.cli: Exactly two path arguments; invalid input exits nonzero and leaves an existing output file's bytes unchanged; do not create an output on validation failure. No network or external dependencies.

contract.stage1: For each id select greatest (at_ms, seq). Exact repeated rows are harmless. Different rows with equal id, at_ms and seq are conflicting and must be rejected.
contract.stage2: User correction replaces stage1 selection: seq is the authoritative revision, so select greatest seq, breaking no ties with timestamps. Any two different rows with the same id and seq are conflicting and must be rejected even if at_ms differs; identical duplicates remain harmless. All other input/output/CLI requirements remain. Correct all affected active output/report claims and keep unrelated work.
